basic_info.name: جامعة مؤتة
basic_info.notes: Founded by royal decree on March 22, 1981 as military wing; civilian wing established 1986. Known as 'University of the Sword and the Pen' due to its unique military-civilian dual structure.

admission_requirements.general_requirements: Tawjihi (General Secondary Education Certificate) or equivalent; admission through unified admission coordination unit of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research; regular (competitive), parallel, and international tracks available
admission_requirements.exam_details: Students must take a proficiency exam during the first semester of admission; passing the exam is required to complete registration

military_wing_colleges: Princess Muna College of Nursing and Allied Medical Professions
Prince Hassan College of Islamic Sciences

tuition_fees.annual_fees_range: [uncertain] Fees vary by admission track (regular unified/parallel/international) and program
tuition_fees.notes: Fees vary by admission track (regular unified/parallel/international) and program. Detailed fee schedules available on university website at /Pages/University-fees.aspx. Fee schedules exist for: bachelor's (regular/parallel/international), diploma, master's (Jordanian/international), doctoral (Jordanian/international), and medical specialization programs.

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of Jordan (MOHE)
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: [uncertain] QS World University Rankings and Times Higher Education rankings referenced on university homepage banners; QS 5-star rating achieved

market_demand.notes: [uncertain] No university-specific employment rate data available on official website

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: Female student housing available; male accommodation through military wing barracks. Housing fund (صندوق الاسكان) available for students.
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Various scholarship and financial support programs available including Royal Hashemite DIWAN Grants and Student Support Fund
notable_centers: Prince Faisal Center for Dead Sea, Environmental and Energy Research
Academic Development and Quality Assurance Center
Queen Rania Al Abdullah Center for Educational and Psychological Studies
